visual_goal: Show screening, incident and claim as one reservation story, with money flowing to the protection ledger and outcomes flowing back as labels to screening.
prompt: A left-to-right loop illustration. Along the top, four rounded boxes connected by bold blue arrows: 'Booking request' with a small calendar icon; arrow labeled 'screening' into 'Reservation' with a small house-and-key icon; arrow labeled 'stay begins' into 'Incident' with a small warning-bell icon; arrow labeled 'evidence' into 'Claim' with a small clipboard icon. From 'Claim' one green arrow down-right into a box 'Protection ledger' with a small ledger-book icon, labeled 'payments'. Below the top row, centered, a box 'Screening model' with a small gauge icon. One orange arrow from 'Incident' down into 'Screening model' and one orange arrow from 'Claim' down into 'Screening model', each labeled 'outcome label'. One orange arrow from 'Screening model' curving back up-left into 'Booking request', labeled 'thresholds'.
alt: Booking request, screened, becomes a reservation; the stay may produce an incident and then a claim, whose payments go to the protection ledger; incident and claim outcomes return as labels to the screening model, which sets thresholds for the next booking.

visual_goal: Show one policy registry feeding screening, incidents and claims, all three writing to the reservation record and one evidence store, with only claims moving money through the ledger to the insurer.
prompt: A top-to-bottom architecture illustration with eight boxes. Top: one box 'Policy registry' with a plain book icon (no text on the book), with three arrows down into a middle row of three boxes side by side: 'Screening' (gauge icon), 'Incidents' (bell icon), 'Claims' (clipboard icon). Directly below the middle row, one wide box 'Reservation record' spanning under all three; each middle box has one short arrow straight down into it. Below 'Reservation record', a smaller box 'Evidence store' with a camera-and-folder icon, placed under 'Incidents' and 'Claims'; two thin arrows run down from 'Incidents' and from 'Claims' along the outside of 'Reservation record' into 'Evidence store'. To the right of 'Claims', one green arrow into a box 'Protection ledger' labeled 'postings', and from it one arrow right into a box 'Insurance partner' drawn as a plain office building with an umbrella icon, labeled 'bordereau'. No other boxes and no other arrows.
alt: A policy registry feeds screening, incidents and claims; all three write to the reservation record; incidents and claims share an evidence store; claims post to the protection ledger, which reports to the insurance partner.

visual_goal: Show the life of a damage claim: the guest's response window first, acceptance skipping adjudication, review possibly referred to the insurer, and payment to the host separate from recovery from the guest.
prompt: A state diagram of eight rounded state bubbles connected by arrows, flowing left to right. 'Filed' arrow to 'Guest response' with a small hourglass icon. From 'Guest response' two arrows: one up-right to a green bubble 'Accepted', and one down-right to 'Under review'. From 'Under review' one arrow to 'Decided' and one arrow down to a bubble 'Insurer' drawn with a small umbrella icon; one arrow from 'Insurer' up to 'Decided'. From 'Decided' one arrow right to a teal bubble 'Paid to host' with a coin icon. One arrow from 'Paid to host' to an orange bubble 'Recovery' with a coin returning icon, and one long arrow from 'Accepted' across the top directly into 'Recovery'. 'Paid to host' and 'Recovery' sit side by side as two clearly separate bubbles.
alt: Claim states: Filed, then Guest response, which leads to Accepted or Under review; review may go to the insurer before Decided; Decided leads to Paid to host, then Recovery; an accepted claim goes straight to Recovery.
